name: vocabkitchen
description: VocabKitchen tools for Claude Code — English vocabulary and grammar profiling by CEFR level.

plugins.name: vocab-profiler
plugins.description: Profile the CEFR level (A1–C2) and academic-vocabulary density (AWL/NAWL) of English text. Dependency-free Python 3.

plugins.name: grammar-profiler
plugins.description: Profile the grammar of English text by CEFR level — which constructions it uses (tenses, aspect, passive, modals, relative clauses, conditionals) and what level each maps to. Rule-based over a spaCy parse; uses the CEFR-J Grammar Profile. Requires Python 3 + spaCy.
